status_rule: NOT_RUN_EXTERNAL_PREREQUISITE is not supported, denied, or passed; it is a visible hold until an authorized tenant observation exists.
required_prerequisite: Pre-authorized non-production tenant/site, usable member identity fixtures, owner-approved Selected grants, and designated records reviewer/role fixtures for protection proof.

p0_document_runner.request: Selected site and library checks; one synthetic upload/edit; exact saved-version readback
p0_document_runner.writes: one synthetic file and one edit; no retry or cleanup

tenant_connection.admin_consent: A tenant administrator connects the organization once; record verified consent and connection audit fields.
tenant_connection.trusted_organization_key: Verified Entra tenant ID; never infer tenant identity from an email domain.
tenant_connection.resource_binding: Persist administrator-selected stable site and library identifiers; names and URLs are discovery/display values only.

identity_lanes.interactive: Use the signed-in user's delegated identity; application authorization and actual SharePoint permission must both allow the operation.
identity_lanes.background: Use a separate least-privilege application/service identity scoped to approved repositories; exact grants remain owner-selected.
identity_lanes.membership: Tenant consent does not add users to SharePoint; preserve and verify each user's actual membership and permissions.
identity_lanes.caller_supplied_targets: Reject arbitrary URLs, site IDs, drive IDs, folder IDs, and Graph paths.

integration_contract.live_state: On 2026-09-18, the designated EasyGuide Microsoft 365 developer tenant was observed with private synthetic sites for Client A, Client B, internal workpapers, two issued-records sites with the same display name, an unrelated site, and a separate AuditSphereDevelopment site. The admin center reports external sharing enabled on created sites; that setting was not changed. The single-tenant AuditSphere P0 app registration has Microsoft Graph delegated User.Read and application Sites.Selected with tenant admin consent. A Graph Explorer signed-in administrator consented to its delegated Sites.FullControl.All scope for permission setup and read-only verification; this is separate from AuditSphere P0 and remains active. AuditSphere P0 has one write site grant on Client A and no grants on Client B, internal workpapers, unrelated, development, or issued-record sites. App-only P0-04 returned Client A metadata HTTP 200 and unrelated metadata HTTP 403. App-only P0-05 returned Client B and unrelated metadata denials, uploaded one deterministic synthetic file to Client A, verified its original and edited bytes, and reconstructed the exact original saved version after the edit; the probe left that file in the test library. Purview Records Management is accessible and its File Plan showed zero labels. The approved 30-day synthetic disposition-review profile remains unapplied because no disposition reviewer was designated; the unsaved label draft was canceled without saving, so no retention setting was changed. No user-identity, revocation, or records-protection proof is claimed.
